disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; EU-AIMS LEAP multicenter clinical cohort; inclusion criterion FSIQ > 70; normative model trained on control subjects and applied to ASD patients
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We studied cerebellar gray matter morphology in 274 individuals with autism and 219 control subjects of a multicenter European cohort, EU-AIMS LEAP"

dataset-of-origin.detail: EU-AIMS LEAP (Longitudinal European Autism Project); large multicenter observational study at 6 sites: Cambridge, London (King's College), Mannheim, Nijmegen, Rome, Utrecht
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We analyzed data from the EU-AIMS LEAP (18). This cohort is a large multicenter observational study, which aims to identify and validate stratification biomarkers in autism. We included individuals from the LEAP cohort (individuals with autism and control subjects recruited in 6 centers) with a Full Scale IQ (FSIQ) > 70."

age.detail: Age statistics for ASD patients (n = 274) as reported in Table 1

sex.detail: Sex ratio reported as 73% males. Male N estimated as round(0.73 × 274) = 200; female N estimated as 274 − 200 = 74; female % = 27.0%. Female N and female % are estimated from total N and reported male percentage.
sex.supporting_text: "Sex Ratio (% of Males)  |  73%" (Patients With ASD, n = 274)
